literal_meaning: strange or ignorant one (from 'ajab' meaning strange in Persian/Urdu influence)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা পুরো উজবুক, কিছুই বোঝে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a complete idiot; he doesn't understand anything.
note: Variant spellings reflect regional pronunciations in Bengali dialects.
